import sys, random, itertools, json, time; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp_tests')
from harness import ok

def brute(qids, cost, matrix, pids):
    pairs = list(itertools.combinations(range(len(pids)),2))
    pindex = {p:i for i,p in enumerate(pids)}
    needed = [ (pindex[a],pindex[b]) for a,b in itertools.combinations(pids,2)
               if any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in qids) ]
    if not needed: return (0,0)
    n=len(qids)
    covers=[]
    for q in qids:
        m=0
        for idx,(i,j) in enumerate(needed):
            if matrix[q][pids[i]] != matrix[q][pids[j]]: m |= 1<<idx
        covers.append(m)
    target=(1<<len(needed))-1
    N=1<<n
    union=[0]*N
    cst=[0]*N
    best=(10**9,10**9)
    for mask in range(1,N):
        lb = mask & (-mask)
        i = lb.bit_length()-1
        rest = mask ^ lb
        union[mask] = union[rest] | covers[i]
        cst[mask] = cst[rest] + cost[qids[i]]
        if union[mask]==target:
            cand=(cst[mask], bin(mask).count('1'))
            if cand<best: best=cand
    return best

random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]))
rng=random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]))
for trial in range(int(sys.argv[2])):
    np_=8; nq=rng.randint(15,20)
    profiles=[{'id':'p%d'%i,'max_aliases':rng.randint(0,3),'cname':rng.choice(['follow','stop']),'wildcard':rng.choice(['rfc','off','one-label'])} for i in range(np_)]
    names=['n%d.test.'%i for i in range(5)]+['x.y.test.','*.test.','deep.sub.test.','outside.']
    queries=[{'id':'Q%02d'%i,'name':rng.choice(names),'type':rng.choice(['A','CNAME','TXT','AAAA']),'cost':rng.choice([1,1,2,3,5,7,11,13,17,25,1000])} for i in range(nq)]
    zones=[{"origin":"test.","records":[
        {"owner":"*.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"end.test."},
        {"owner":"end.test.","type":"A","data":"192.0.2.5"},
        {"owner":"leaf.block.test.","type":"TXT","data":"e"},
        {"owner":"*.sub.test.","type":"A","data":"198.51.100.2"},
        {"owner":"n0.test.","type":"AAAA","data":"2001:DB8::1"},
        {"owner":"n1.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"n2.test."},
        {"owner":"n2.test.","type":"TXT","data":"tt"},
        {"owner":"n3.test.","type":"A","data":"192.0.2.3"},
        {"owner":"n4.test.","type":"A","data":"192.0.2.4"}]},
       {"origin":"sub.test.","records":[{"owner":"deep.sub.test.","type":"A","data":"203.0.113.9"}]}]
    doc={'zones':zones,'profiles':profiles,'queries':queries,'observations':[]}
    t0=time.time()
    res=ok(doc)
    t1=time.time()
    pids=sorted(p['id'] for p in profiles); qids=sorted(q['id'] for q in queries)
    matrix={}
    for run in res['runs']:
        matrix.setdefault(run['query'],{})[run['profile']]=(run['rcode'],frozenset((a['owner'],a['type'],a['data']) for a in run['answer']))
    cost={q['id']:q['cost'] for q in queries}
    bc,bn=brute(qids,cost,matrix,pids)
    d=res['diagnostic']
    assert (d['cost'],d['count'])==(bc,bn),(trial,d,(bc,bn),qids,cost)
    pairs=[(a,b) for a,b in itertools.combinations(pids,2) if any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in qids)]
    for a,b in pairs:
        assert any(matrix[q][a]!=matrix[q][b] for q in d['basis'])
    print('trial',trial,'nq',nq,'sub %.2fs'%(t1-t0),'opt',(bc,bn),'ours',(d['cost'],d['count']))
print('OK seed', sys.argv[1])
